verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.159
16. Saddhammavagga
Udāyīsutta
Evaṁ me sutaṁ—
ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā kosambiyaṁ viharati ghositārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Kosambī, in Ghosita’s Monastery.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā udāyī mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṁ desento nisinno hoti.
verses.english: Now, at that time Venerable Udāyī was sitting teaching Dhamma, surrounded by a large assembly of laypeople.

verses.pali: Addasā kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṁ udāyiṁ mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivutaṁ dhammaṁ desentaṁ nisinnaṁ.
Disvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:

verses.pali: “āyasmā, bhante, udāyī mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṁ desetī”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, Venerable Udāyī is teaching Dhamma, surrounded by a large assembly of laypeople.”

verses.pali: “Na kho, ānanda, sukaraṁ paresaṁ dhammaṁ desetuṁ.
verses.english: “Ānanda, it’s not easy to teach Dhamma to others.

verses.pali: Paresaṁ, ānanda, dhammaṁ desentena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṁ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṁ dhammo desetabbo.
verses.english: You should establish five things in yourself before teaching Dhamma to others.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
‘Anupubbiṁ kathaṁ kathessāmī’ti paresaṁ dhammo desetabbo;
verses.english: You should teach Dhamma to others thinking: ‘I will teach step by step.’ …

verses.pali: ‘pariyāyadassāvī kathaṁ kathessāmī’ti paresaṁ dhammo desetabbo;
‘anuddayataṁ paṭicca kathaṁ kathessāmī’ti paresaṁ dhammo desetabbo;
‘na āmisantaro kathaṁ kathessāmī’ti paresaṁ dhammo desetabbo;
verses.english: ‘I will not teach while secretly hoping to profit.’ …

verses.pali: ‘attānañca parañca anupahacca kathaṁ kathessāmī’ti paresaṁ dhammo desetabbo.
verses.english: ‘I will teach without damaging myself or others.’

verses.pali: Na kho, ānanda, sukaraṁ paresaṁ dhammaṁ desetuṁ.
verses.english: It’s not easy to teach Dhamma to others.

verses.pali: Paresaṁ, ānanda, dhammaṁ desentena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṁ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṁ dhammo desetabbo”ti.
verses.english: You should establish these five things in yourself before teaching Dhamma to others.”

verses.pali: Navamaṁ.
